name: @lunaris/lunapack
description: LunaPack is a CLI for managing and consuming packs of reusable content.

scripts.build:pitch: marp docs/pitch/business-pitch.md --html --output docs/pitch/business-pitch.html && marp docs/pitch/tech-pitch.md --html --output docs/pitch/tech-pitch.html
scripts.format: npm run format:csharp && npm run format:docs && npm run format:prettier
scripts.format:csharp: dotnet format style projects/cli/src/Lunapack.slnx --severity info && dotnet csharpier format projects
